# Applied AI Society Documentation

> Public documentation for the Applied AI Society: playbooks, philosophy, concepts, roles, and frameworks for the applied AI economy.

## Docs

- [Co-Steward With Us](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/about/co-stewardship)
- [Humanity-First Flywheel](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/about/humanity-first-flywheel): How the four Applied AI Society communities (business leaders, artists, students, builders) compound value for each other, and why we lead with humanity, not compute.
- [What is the Applied AI Society?](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/about)
- [License](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/about/license): How the Applied AI Society public documentation is licensed and what you can do with it.
- [Who We Serve](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/about/who-we-serve): The four communities Applied AI Society is built around: non-developer business leaders, artists, students, and the top applied AI engineers who sanity-check everything we publish.
- [Get Activated / Subscribe](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/activate): Get in touch with Applied AI Society, follow us on social platforms, and subscribe to our newsletter.
- [The Applied AI Literacy Earthshot](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/applied-ai-practice/earthshot): Our commitment: the best open-source source material for applied AI literacy in the world, co-created by leading practitioners. The activation bar. We cannot force practice or mastery; we can open the door to literacy and hold it open for everyone.
- [The Applied AI Discipline](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/applied-ai-practice): Applied AI Society champions the applied AI discipline: the daily discipline of wielding AI to advance your will in the world. Embodied, progressive, lifelong. Source material, courses, and frameworks evolving in real time.
- [Generating Assets with AI](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/brand/ai-generation)
- [Brand Guidelines](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/brand)
- [Case Studies](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/case-studies)
- [Ramp: Glass](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/case-studies/ramp-glass)
- [Rostam Mahabadi](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/case-studies/rostam-mahabadi)
- [Code of Conduct](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/code-of-conduct)
- [Activation](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/concepts/activation)
- [Agent-Accessible Products](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/concepts/agent-accessible-products)
- [Agentic Exploration](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/concepts/agentic-exploration)
- [Agentic Harness](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/concepts/agentic-harness)
- [Agentic Harnesses Are For Everyone](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/concepts/agentic-harnesses-for-everyone): An agentic harness is for any knowledge worker whose brain has to develop and execute a strategy that touches a computer. Not just coders. The future standard team has at least one harness-fluent member moving at speeds that were not previously possible, and more of them every quarter.
- [Agentic OS Debt](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/concepts/agentic-os-debt)
- [Agentic Relationship Management](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/concepts/agentic-relationship-management): The active practice that turns your PRM from a database into a deal pipeline. Your Jarvis interviews you about the people who matter, ingests every conversation automatically, and prompts you to follow up before things slip. The highest-leverage thing most practitioners are not doing yet.
- [Agentic Strategy](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/concepts/agentic-strategy)
- [Agentic UX Rules](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/concepts/agentic-ux-rules)
- [The AGI Whisperer](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/concepts/agi-whisperer)
- [Always-On Agents](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/concepts/always-on-agents)
- [Anatomy of a Harness: Lessons from Claude Code's Source](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/concepts/anatomy-of-a-harness)
- [Anchor of a Scene](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/concepts/anchor-of-a-scene)
- [Angels in the Attributes](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/concepts/angels-in-the-attributes): The ungoogleable edge intelligence that determines whether a deal lands, a pitch works, a hire compounds, or a relationship deepens. Small, specific, easy-to-miss attributes of a person or situation that no public search surfaces. Held in your head they do not scale. Written into your Jarvis workspace they compound every week.
- [The Applied AI Discipline](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/concepts/applied-ai-practice): The daily discipline of living and operating with AI. Embodied, progressive, lifelong. Everyone who intends to stay commercially and creatively relevant is now a daily applied AI practitioner.
- [Applied AI Practitioner](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/concepts/applied-ai-practitioner): The person walking the applied AI discipline. Anyone who wants to stay relevant, commercially viable, and sustainably successful in the work they care about needs to become one. A daily practitioner at minimum; a pro practitioner if they make it their career.
- [Applied AI](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/concepts/applied-ai): The highest and best use of AI in service of whatever you are working toward. Not confined to business. Any goal a human can hold (commercial, creative, civic, personal, public good) qualifies. The defining question is not what AI can do; it is what a human has decided to use it to accomplish.
- [Applied Politics](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/concepts/applied-politics): The relational and political navigation that determines whether an applied AI deployment actually lands. Most lists of essential applied AI roles name domain expertise and harness fluency. They miss the third role: the one who can read the room, build the coalition, and get the decision through.
- [Being Someone's Go-To Person](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/concepts/being-someones-go-to-person)
- [Build What Big AI Won't](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/concepts/build-what-big-ai-wont)
- [Capture, Process, Compound](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/concepts/capture-process-compound)
- [CLIPs: The Apps of the Agentic Era](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/concepts/clips)
- [Command Centers](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/concepts/command-centers)
- [Community of Practice](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/concepts/community-of-practice)
- [Compound Drift](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/concepts/compound-drift)
- [Compounding Docs](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/concepts/compounding-docs)
- [Computer Use](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/concepts/computer-use): Your agent operating your mouse and keyboard by seeing the screen the way you do. The universal fallback for every app that has no API, no CLI, and no MCP server, which is still most of them. In 2026, computer use stopped being a demo and became a working tool.
- [Conjoined Agency](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/concepts/conjoined-agency)
- [Context Engineering](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/concepts/context-engineering)
- [Context Lake](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/concepts/context-lake)
- [Context Overflow](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/concepts/context-overflow)
- [Context Searching](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/concepts/context-searching)
- [Corporate Upskilling](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/concepts/corporate-upskilling): What good corporate AI upskilling actually requires: analysis, non-vendor-specific literacy, hands-on Jarvis installs, and activation. Plus six criteria for choosing a corporate upskilling partner. AAS does not sell corporate upskilling; this page describes what the work requires.
- [Creative Congestion](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/concepts/creative-congestion)
- [Crutching](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/concepts/crutching)
- [Don't Put The App On A Pedestal](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/concepts/dont-put-the-app-on-a-pedestal)
- [Effective AGI](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/concepts/effective-agi)
- [Externalize Your Brain](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/concepts/externalize-your-brain)
- [Fat Skills](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/concepts/fat-skills)
- [The Flaming Red Elephant in the Room](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/concepts/flaming-red-elephant): The obvious political reality that AI discourse keeps refusing to name. Red for the communist-revolutionary spirit rising in a generation locked out of the economy. Flaming for the firebombs already being thrown at AI executives and data centers. Elephant for the simple fact the cause is obvious and nobody at the top of the industry wants to look at it.
- [Flow-State Infra](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/concepts/flow-state-infra)
- [Forkable Is the New Sticky](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/concepts/forkable-is-the-new-sticky)
- [The Four Levels of Applied AI for Existing Businesses](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/concepts/four-levels-of-applied-ai-for-existing-businesses)
- [Game Design](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/concepts/game-design)
- [Give Your Agent a Voice](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/concepts/give-your-agent-a-voice)
- [Harness Engineering](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/concepts/harness-engineering)
- [Human Comparative Advantage](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/concepts/human-comparative-advantage): The applied AI engineer's job is to be the supersuit engineer for an essential human role. Save them from drudgery so they can stay in the human-only work only they can do. That work is also where their sustained commercial success lives.
- [Human Emulators](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/concepts/human-emulators)
- [Human Skills](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/concepts/human-skills): The skills that require human presence to perform. The ones AI cannot replicate because they live in presence, taste, judgment, care, and lived experience. The ones that increasingly define sustained commercial success as AI automates everything else. The general category and the specific-to-you shape of it are both where your durable market edge lives.
- [Human Slop Factory](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/concepts/human-slop-factory)
- [Hyperagency](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/concepts/hyperagency)
- [Hypercontext Protocol](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/concepts/hypercontext-protocol)
- [Ignorance Debt](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/concepts/ignorance-debt)
- [Imagination Economy Infrastructure](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/concepts/imagination-economy-infrastructure)
- [The Imagination Economy](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/concepts/imagination-economy): The emerging economy where imagination, backed by applied AI leverage and the right team, is the primary asset. Companies and technologies that couldn't have existed before 2026, applying AI while centering humans at the highest possible level.
- [Inclusive Technological Advancement](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/concepts/inclusive-technological-advancement)
- [Concepts](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/concepts)

- [Jevons Paradox](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/concepts/jevons-paradox)
- [Judgment Burnout](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/concepts/judgment-burnout)
- [Latent Leverage](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/concepts/latent-leverage): The deals that are already possible through the relationships you have already built, waiting to be activated. For people with years or decades of earned trust in a specific world, latent leverage is the largest undeployed asset they own. A Jarvis is the operating system that activates it.
- [Learn the Harness, Not the Wrapper](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/concepts/learn-the-harness-not-the-wrapper)

- [Observable Behavior Engineering](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/concepts/observable-behavior-engineering)
- [Ontology As Substrate](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/concepts/ontology-as-substrate): The canonical definition layer underneath every reliable AI implementation. Without a shared ontology of the domain's objects and roles, agents drift into hallucination. With one, they operate on rails.
- [Ontology-Driven Development](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/concepts/ontology-driven-development): The methodology of writing software around a canonical model of the business, not around the APIs of the underlying tools. The development discipline that turns a strong ontology into compounding software for both human operators and AI agents.

- [Regenerative AI Advancement](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/concepts/regenerative-ai-advancement): The frame we commit to: AI advancement that regenerates rather than pillages. Good for people, good for the planet, all-win. The design posture that makes the AI transition worth showing up for.
- [Robot Mode](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/concepts/robot-mode)

- [Scam Literacy](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/concepts/scam-literacy): A real-time, community-maintained awareness of how scams currently work. A subset of applied AI literacy that everyone needs, and that nobody can get from a textbook.

- [Sustained Commercial Success](https://docs.appliedaisociety.org/docs/concepts/sustained-commercial-success): The outcome Applied AI Society optimizes for: the right onboarding to AI, which is a different road from the easiest onboarding. The kind that produces leaders who can actually build and sustain commercial edge in an economy that is rewriting itself.

That model has not updated. Until you have felt your AI do real creative work for you, you cannot reason accurately about what is now possible.
